name: GenerateBlake3Hash
description: Generates a Blake3 hash. Blake3 is the latest in the Blake family - very fast, parallelizable, and supports arbitrary output lengths (XOF).
syntax: GenerateBlake3Hash( any input, [numeric outputLength], [any key], [string context] )

params.name: outputLength
params.description: Output length in bytes (any length, default 32)

params.name: key
params.description: Key for keyed hash mode (MAC), must be exactly 32 bytes

params.name: context
params.description: Context string for key derivation mode
